# 136 Camps on the 8:00–9:00 sector — Black Rock City 2026

Camp placements are official Burning Man Project data and may be shown to users from Aug 23 12:01am (the dataset terms lift the camp-location embargo then; this release ships Aug 27). Playa Pal is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or verified by Burning Man Project.

## Abominable Base Camp

**Where:** 8:30 & C · **From:** Tucson · **Landmark:** Snowglobe entrance with a colorful tree of flags · **Year:** 2026

Home of the Yeti Mob. We host a welcoming base camp for BRC citizens--providing cool daytime vibes and an immersive lit nighttime environment. ABC will have live DJs, parties, workshops, a book nook, and a bar for custom infused vodka tasting. Come get abominable with us.

## Acid On Ice

**Where:** C & 8:45 · **Landmark:** Giant blow up Santa Clause · **Year:** 2026

Step into a snowstorm of silliness at Acid on Ice! We're a frosty oasis serving chilled vibes, mulled wines, and warm welcomes. Join us at our snow-themed lounge and bar for mist-cooled hangouts, icy karaoke, and popsicle mischief. Whether you're escaping the heat or diving into connection, our camp is your winter wonderland in the dust.

## Altitude Lounge

**Where:** B & 8:15 · **From:** Boise · **Landmark:** 50' scaffolding tower with Altitude Lounge sign · **Year:** 2026

Come lounge on our tower anytime, any day. Get the best view of the playa and see what you helped create. Enjoy our down-tempo beats leading into sunset.

*More: https://www.facebook.com/loungeluv*

## AmberDust

**Where:** 8:00 & F · **From:** Los Angeles · **Landmark:** AmberDust Express ArtCar · **Year:** 2026

A retro-futuristic lounge camp built around the AmberDust Express art installation, blending interactive lights, music, shade, and spontaneous social chaos. Wander in for glowing nighttime vibes, unexpected conversations, late-night dancing, and our legendary returning sausage parties. By day, relax in our shaded gathering space; by night, watch the camp transform into an illuminated social playground. Come curious, leave slightly confused and hopefully well-fed.

## Analog

**Where:** F & 8:15 · **From:** California Republic · **Landmark:** white camo capony and Analog Brain Mutant Vehicle · **Year:** 2026

## Apokalyptika

**Where:** A & 8:15 · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** Large swing set and 40" disco ball, lit at night. · **Year:** 2026

We are proud to be an eco conscious kamp that strives to re-envision waste materials into art. Come chill out with us and have a beverage in our post Apokalpytikally themed sunset bar and 24 hr lounge, or play with our eclectic collection of installations and games.

*More: https://www.instagram.com/kampapokalyptika*

## Après-Ski

**Where:** B & 8:15 · **From:** Verbier · **Landmark:** 2 large red ski cabins/gondolas - lit up at night · **Year:** 2026

Shimmering on the horizon is a sight that shouldn't exist: a pocket of Swiss mountain magic in the middle of a prehistoric lake bed. An Alpine outpost where high-altitude hospitality meets the Playa dust. By day, seek refuge in our Ski Cabin Wine Bar. We're gifting crisp Swiss pours and mountain vibes to the soundtrack of Euro-house. Feeling bold? Take on the Ski Pass Challenge? and who knows where you may end up.. Perhaps in a fluffy fur lined speakeasy? Follow the scent of roasting potatoes and Alpine funk to our doorstep for an interactive feast of bubbling cheese and laughter. Whether you're here for the vintage, the challenge, or the midnight melt, the mountains are calling... and they taste like home.

## Arctica Ice Sales

**Where:** Center Camp Plaza @ 8:00 · **From:** Iceland · **Landmark:** Igloo · **Year:** 2026

## Astro Cats

**Where:** 8:00 & A · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** Aerial Rig with lights at night · **Year:** 2026

We invite all burners to chill at the Flying Saucer Lounge with special cocktails during the day, and hot or cold sake or premium Tequila at the Dragon Lounge during the evening. You can enjoy acrobatic, fire dancing performance and workshops at scheduled times, and a place to practice and spin fire with us. If you want to join our kitties for morning yoga or a afternoon tandem running race, bring your mat to stretch and pose with us You can chill on our chairs and watch people pass by while sipping our special drinks. You can learn to be a puppet master and perform at our Improv Puppet Theatre. You can challenge yourself to walk the plank, or play the game of Giant Jenga, or play poker at our game table while enjoying your sake. Yes, we also invite your for our night sky star tours!

*More: https://sites.google.com/view/astrocats/home*

## ASTRO SHACK JaVa JoINt

**Where:** 8:30 & A · **From:** Seattle · **Landmark:** beatnik coffee house in a carport and glowing sign · **Year:** 2026

Delicious coffee served in a cool space with extraordinary hospitality. Fresh ground French press dark roast brewed black as the depths of interstellar space itself (BYO creamer if you must adulterate). The hangout for quasi-legal alien beatniks, mutant cyborg gear heads, trans-solar scooter gangs, radical anarchist raypunks, neuroatypical geeks, freaked-out psychonauts, and caffeine fiends of every stripe.

*More: https://www.facebook.com/groups/astroshack*

## Barbots: Baby Needs A Break

**Where:** D & 8:45 · **From:** Santa Barbara · **Landmark:** Pink BARBOTS flags, Snuggle Dome, and Struggle Bus · **Year:** 2026

Feeling dusty, crooked, or cosmically misaligned? Does Baby Need a Break? The Barbots have you covered. Wander in for pop up bar hours, spa style pampering, karaoke, champagne saber lessons, and our famous Struggle Bus for anyone whose Burn has gone sideways. Recover at Tuesday Bruncho de los Muertos, branch out at Wednesday Cosmic Treehouse Happy Hour, realign your dusty axis at the Day Spa, or bounce through the Cosmic Portal of Doom. Expect strong drinks, shady lounging, and plenty of questionable life decisions.

## Base Camp

**Where:** G & 8:45 · **From:** Reno · **Landmark:** The Die Cut Metro Chop sign · **Year:** 2026

Home and landing pad for the Metro Chop mutant vehicle. A working camp where stuff gets done so the Black Rock City can have some fun.

*More: https://www.facebook.com/share/p/1AynqsHvsg/*

## Best Butt

**Where:** B & 8:45 · **From:** Seattle · **Landmark:** TWERK Wall next to a Peach Dome with a Peach Arch · **Year:** 2026

Camp Best Butt is dedicated to the relentless appreciation and promotion of all things buttocks related. How do you achieve the Best Butt? It's 90% confidence and 10% squats.

*More: https://www.instagram.com/bestbuttcamp/*

## Bisous

**Where:** E & 8:45 · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** Silk Road Courtyard · **Year:** 2026

Welcome to Bisous. We are an experiential theme camp and non-profit co-created by a team with backgrounds in experience design, community building, and history building theme camps on playa.

## Black Hole Literary Society

**Where:** 8:30 & B · **From:** Marina Del Rey · **Landmark:** Giant Brite Lite, Three tents. 30 foot lit pole. · **Year:** 2026

COME PLAY!! Grow old, not up. By day rest in our shady lounge and hydrate, color, knit, play games and talk. After dark, lose yourself in our immersive 360 degree 3-D black-light experience! Watch the moths dance in their special disco club. Come flow to some vibey tunes, create a visual masterpiece on our Giant Bright Light, and warm yourself at our campfire. Join us late on Thursday night for 'Elvis Hour' around 8 pm followed by a night of music with words through the decades and psychedelic rock. Friday we welcome ALL for our annual Shabbat potluck at sundown - bring some food to share or simply come and enjoy! We dig high fives, interpretive dance, and hula hoops, meaningful conversation, and old-school burners. WELCOME HOME! We've missed you. Let's share and play.

## Black Rock City Pickleball Club

**Where:** 8:00 & B · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** Full size lit pickleball court, sign, and bar · **Year:** 2026

Step off your bike and onto the court. This full size pickleball playground on playa turns strangers into teammates and sends laughter flying farther than the ball. Learn the game in minutes, cheer from the sidelines, or rotate into your next match, no experience or equipment required. Rally at sunrise, dink at dusk, or glow under the lights after dark. Movement, connection, and a little friendly competition await.

*More: https://www.instagram.com/brcpickleballclub/*

## Black Rock Socks

**Where:** C & 8:15 · **From:** Los Angeles and beyond · **Landmark:** Look for the RV painted as the ocean · **Year:** 2026

Come by for Chocolate Roulette, Tea and Shock Collar Karaoke for a magical time

## Black Rock University

**Where:** 8:30 & A · **From:** Reno · **Landmark:** Black Rock University flag on a long flagpole. · **Year:** 2026

Black Rock University teaches Playa Survival Skills and Best Practices. The 10 Principles of Burning Man. 10 Principles of Couples Survival and other Playa Centric courses and outreach. Virgin 101, Get your playa name. Fairy Shrimp 101.

## Black Rock Yacht Club

**Where:** 8:45 & K · **From:** inverness · **Landmark:** Orange wind sock, Red BRYC banners on tall masts · **Year:** 2026

We share our love of sailing by offering instruction, and use of our fleet of wind-powered rigs

## Bubbles and Bass

**Where:** Esplanade & 8:15 · **From:** New York City · **Landmark:** Sand-colored shade sails with a warm glow · **Year:** 2026

Bubbles and Bass is a 100% volunteer run art and music collective that brings joy to burner events worldwide! Our goal is to provide a home conducive to connecting: spiritually, conversationally, energetically. Best known for our sunrise to midday dancing revelry: more Bubbles and Bass makes the playa a magical place!

*More: http://bubblesandbass.com*

## Burning Globe

**Where:** C & 8:45 · **From:** New York City · **Landmark:** Burning Globe Sign · **Year:** 2026

Thespian? Thespian-curious? Do you have lots of Thespian friends? Well, round here, we call that an "ally" If that sounds like you, come join us for a chalice-full of tomfoolery, skullduggery, swashbuckle...ery and overall merriment. Theatrics! Catharsis! Comedy! Tragedy... catch a show--or be a part of one! We'll make you a fancy cocktail after the performance... ...if you can find our bar, that is.

*More: https://www.facebook.com/BurningGlobePublic*

## BurningShip

**Where:** 8:00 & C · **From:** Las Vegas · **Landmark:** A sailboat & box truck with "BurningShip" on side · **Year:** 2026

There are Wood Ships, there are Steel ships, but the best ships are "FriendShips." A bunch of hippie shipmates from all over the world bring their FriendSHIP to the desert for a week of debauchery! Join us at "BurningShip," a cruise ship full of immoral crew that's currently stranded in the desert! We'll be your booze directors, providing you with drinks, smiles, and fun events. Learn how to salsa dance, smoke a premium stogie, and let's get "Knotty!" Come with no expectations and leave feeling full. Full of love, hugs, laughs, and WTFs. And most importantly long lasting Burning(friend)Ships.

*More: https://burningshipcamp.com/*

## Camp (Can't) Stop

**Where:** 8:00 & A · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** STOP SIGNS · **Year:** 2026

Camp (Can't) STOP - purveyors of joy and peddlers of silly. What are we up to? You'll just have to STOP by and find out. We'd never STOP a good time - but we might STOP your journey for something way better than whatever it was you were planning on doing. We can't STOP won't STOP and are committed to the bit - whatever that bit might be.

## Camp Bare Tentacles

**Where:** C & 8:15 · **From:** Maui · **Landmark:** Inflatable tentacle · **Year:** 2026

We offer a simple mix of bodywork, basic hospitality, and low key communal space. On Monday and Thursday afternoons we serve hot dogs/vegan dogs and easy tropical cocktails, giving neighbors a chill place to pause and refuel. After dark, we maintain a small fire pit where people can gather, warm up, and unwind. We also offer massages on Tuesday and Thursday. Come by anytime and fly one of our kites! Aloha!

## Camp Castaway

**Where:** 8:00 & E · **From:** Reno · **Landmark:** Camp Castaway sign, large Castaway box, brown tent · **Year:** 2026

A welcoming, shaded, interactive neighborhood lounge where participants of all ages can stop in, engage, and connect. Our primary gift to Black Rock City will be freshly prepared micheladas, a traditional Mexican beer cocktail made with beer, savory Bloody-Mary-style mix, and chili-lime salt on the rim. We offer life size games, lively conversation, and will gift Nevada pendants one day during the week.

## Camp Emergency

**Where:** 8:00 & B · **From:** Park City, Utah · **Landmark:** "Draw on our Duck" Large art piece @ front of camp · **Year:** 2026

A Burning Man camp that embodies the ethos of self-expression, communal living, and radical self-reliance. The camp is a vibrant and inclusive community that fosters creativity and encourages its members to embrace their unique identities. The camp's central gathering space provides an area for participants to connect, relax, and engage in creative pursuits. From sunrise yoga sessions to late-night dance parties, Emergency offers a dynamic and welcoming environment for all who seek to explore the boundaries of self-expression and community.

## Camp Equilibrium

**Where:** C & 8:45 · **From:** Norther California · **Landmark:** Alternating Red and Yellow Flags on the street · **Year:** 2026

Equilibrium has been established as a destination to represent the pinnacle for the collective first world culture in which we live: vacation. Adhering to a strict belief that our shared time together should be one of joy and relaxation, we seek to strike the all too difficult balance of hard work and play. It is here that we have constructed a series of spaces and activities to ensure that all who step through our threshold experience the relaxation, camaraderie, and playfulness that we all deserve outside the hectic worlds of which we live the other 51 weeks of the year. "Because it's vacation for fucks sake."

*More: https://equilibrium.camp*

## Camp Hot Cheeks

**Where:** B & 8:15 · **From:** New York City · **Landmark:** Yellow & black butterfly sign & living room layout · **Year:** 2026

A theme camp focused on having fun, engaging with the BRC community, and inviting people to enjoy our lounge and nonsense. We host an annual event, called Sake Bomb Sunday, the Sunday after the man burns. Sake Bomb Sunday is an end-of-burn tradition at Camp Hot Cheeks. It is a day of celebration and camaraderie. Burners from all walks of life come together to enjoy sake bombs and celebrate the end of the burn.

## Camp Nafas

**Where:** E & 8:15 · **From:** San Francisco, Bay Area · **Landmark:** Persian Lanterns, cushions · **Year:** 2026

A Persian-inspired oasis celebrating freedom, secularity, equality, and the spirit of shared humanity. Inspired by the Persian tradition of hospitality and gathering, our camp invites Burners to connect through tea, music, poetry, dance, and conversation. Visitors can participate in cultural experiences such as Persian calligraphy, language mini-lessons, poetry readings, and communal tea ceremonies. Through these interactive offerings, we create a welcoming space where people can slow down, breathe, and share meaningful moments with others. Camp Nafas brings the warmth of Persian culture to the playa while embracing Burning Man's principles of participation, gifting, and radical inclusion.

## Camp Slow Your Roll

**Where:** B & 8:15 · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** Camp Slow Your Roll flags, Start/Finish race flags · **Year:** 2026

Take inspiration from the sloth and give in to the deadly sin. Take a breath, put a pause on your carefully laid out plans and just slow your roll. No need to rush! Land in a sloth's dream jungle paradise. Come hang with us where everything is, you guessed it, slooowly done. Move as slow as you can at Slow Drunk Yoga and Slow Sloth Line Dancing. Experience the Best Worst Sloth Cocktail Lounge for the best tasting cocktails and mocktails on the playa but with the worst (slowest) service. While you wait for your drink, try to win the Slowest Bike Race by finishing last (don't fall!). Come channel your inner sloth to take a chill pill anytime by stopping by for photos in sloth onesies at our Sloth Pun Photo Booth, walking the slackline, and playing cornhole, ladder ball, Jenga, and Connect 4.

*More: https://www.instagram.com/campslowyourroll/*

## Caravan D'Light

**Where:** E & 8:15 · **Landmark:** Large Gate of Liberation and the Iron Butterfly · **Year:** 2026

Caravan of Light (COL) is an Art Camp at Heart! We are a global collective of Artists from diverse cultures, coming together to share our unique gifts - visual and performance art, music, dance, holistic teachings, and a deeper understanding of Burning Man Hospitality. In line with our BM Ethos of "Radical Inclusion" - Every Black Rock City Citizen is warmly Welcomed!!!

*More: https://caravandlight.com/*

## Celestial Tea Garden

**Where:** E & 8:45 · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** LED Signs and Giant Stretch Tent · **Year:** 2026

Welcome to Celestial Tea Garden Camp, a vibrant, women-led, multicultural oasis celebrating the rich diversity of culture in our vibrant zen tea dome amidst the dusty canvas of Burning Man. We are multi culture camp bringing asian traditions to the playa. Our camp is a sanctuary where ancient traditions meet modern playfulness, all dedicated to fostering a deep sense of community, understanding, and radical inclusion.

## Chicken Cooter Soup

**Where:** F & 8:15 · **From:** 6:45 G · **Landmark:** A large 40ft silver side megabus · **Year:** 2026

A band of misfits, born of the playa, one living above the peaks of Donner, dedicated to give back via hot dogs, icy treats, and carnival games

## Chop Shop

**Where:** 8:00 & E · **From:** Los Angeles · **Landmark:** The large Chop Shop sign mounted on scaffolding · **Year:** 2026

We are the best BRC bicycle repair shop. We have bicycle repairs, parts and welding.

## Cirkus Freaks

**Where:** D & 8:15 · **From:** Seattle · **Landmark:** Red & yellow Cirkus Freaks sign · **Year:** 2026

Cirkus freak, mutant vehicle.

## Cloud 9

**Where:** 8:00 & C · **From:** New York · **Landmark:** Large Fire Pit at the entrance · **Year:** 2026

We are a live music, deep ancestral camp that jumps between mayhem and meditation depending on the day and whether we've had breakfast. We wish to preserve clean water for future generations. To that end, we will provide only cold beer to the filthy citizens of Burning Man.

## CrazyCamera & Christmas Every Day

**Where:** F & 8:15 · **From:** San Diego · **Landmark:** Huge surfboard above the shade "CRAZY CAMERA" · **Year:** 2026

Where you can make crazy picture, burn the wooden frame for it and celebrate Christmass

*More: https://www.facebook.com/CampCrazyCamera*

## Darkwad Patrol

**Where:** C & 8:15 · **From:** Tucson · **Landmark:** Giant Light Bulb · **Year:** 2026

The mission of our theme camp is to increase nighttime safety in BRC by reducing the number of injuries and damage caused by collisions with inadequately lit burners, bikes and structures. To accomplish this mission we gift lights to dark burners and their bikes and engage in community outreach efforts to promote the importance of remaining visible at night. Darkwad Patrol hosts lighting workshops about the many ways to accessorize your bike and body with lights. We also provide a 24-hour Light-Share Drop Box where burners can gift lights to fellow burners and dark burners can take the lights they need.

## DayCare

**Where:** A & 8:45 · **From:** Los Angeles · **Landmark:** Baby Strollers Parked Out Front · **Year:** 2026

Burn Scouts are the OG rad scouts, sometimes audacious, always fun, lovable and welcoming. Scouts honor!

## Death Guild Thunderdon't

**Where:** 8:30 & A · **From:** Oakland, California · **Landmark:** bitter goths in aloha shirts and mad max vehicles · **Year:** 2026

Have you seen our dome? We haven't.

*More: http://www.deathguildthunderdome.com/*

## Disco Space Shuttle

**Where:** E & 8:15 · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** Disco Space Shuttle MV out front · **Year:** 2026

Home of the Disco Space Shuttle Mutant Vehicle and Camp. Board with us at 10pm and take a ride around the Universe and Beyond.

*More: https://www.instagram.com/discospaceshuttle/*

## Disorient

**Where:** Esplanade & 8:00 · **From:** New York · **Landmark:** Big bright orange "D26" art piece named CoSign · **Year:** 2026

Disorient has been setting Burning Man ablaze since 2001. We are art-centered, compassionate, open-source, and, above all, Pornj. We greet you with love, both playful and sexy, and awaken the Disorient within you, spreading our spirit far and wide: Do it yourself. Do more. Do it all.

*More: https://wiki.disorient.info/index.php?title=Main_Page*

## DJ University

**Where:** E & 8:45 · **From:** Los Angeles · **Landmark:** DJ University sign, colorful Mary Pickford RV · **Year:** 2026

Step into a participatory music campus where beginners become DJs and strangers become collaborators. Start in the rhythm circle, learn the fundamentals of mixing, build your own set, and take the stage for a live showcase supported by the community. Open deck hours, guided workshops, and an optional music creation lab invite you to move from observer to creator. Whether you have never touched a DJ controller or are ready to refine your sound, this is your chance to contribute to the pulse of Black Rock City. Walk away and return, saying, "I DJ'd at Burning Man!"

## Do not confuse here

**Where:** A & 8:45 · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** Thought bubble LED sign · **Year:** 2026

Not confusing area. We support the Beacon of Confusion.

## DUST STARS COLLECTIVE

**Where:** 8:30 & E · **From:** GUADALAJARA · **Landmark:** Silver shade with Dual Hydration sign · **Year:** 2026

Stop by for a refreshing boost in the dust at our dual hydration station. We offer fresh iced coffee to jumpstart your mornings and spicy micheladas to celebrate the midday sun. Relax in our comfortable shaded lounge while enjoying chill beats and great company. Our space is a welcoming gift for all citizens looking to cool down and connect with the neighborhood.

*More: https://www.instagram.com/duststars.collective/*

## Elsewhere Institute

**Where:** A & 8:45 · **From:** Incline Vaillage · **Landmark:** Elsewhere Institute sign · **Year:** 2026

Interactive science museum that finally explains why we remember experiencing history differently, known as the 'Mandela effect'

*More: https://faffe.art*

## Extinct Oasis

**Where:** B & 8:45 · **From:** San Diego · **Landmark:** 20' tall black starshade and Extinct Oasis signage · **Year:** 2026

Trust your senses, this is not a mirage! Extinct Oasis is a shaded, mist-cooled, prehistoric-themed space mixing up refreshing drinks and tasty beats. Get a break from the sun, hydrate with a tasty cocktail/mocktail, dance to music (with words), or just lounge on our comfy oversized blowup furniture.

## Flying Pegasus

**Where:** A & 8:45 · **From:** Austin, Texas · **Landmark:** Wire-art sculptures that are well lit at night. · **Year:** 2026

Fulfilling Fanciful Flying Ferry Function (for a Fucked-up Flat-Foot) Wire-art Pegasus 'flying' mutant vehicle presenting in MOBL form providing fanciful transportation and refreshments

## French Fruits

**Where:** 8:00 & D · **From:** Paris · **Landmark:** Fresh Fruit stand with colorful signs · **Year:** 2026

French Fruits is a small camp with a simple and heartfelt mission: bringing fresh fruit to the playa every day as a free gift to Black Rock City. In a desert environment where cold, hydrating, and nutritious food is rare, we believe in offering ripe pieces of fruit. We bring our love of French cuisine and food culture with us to the desert. When you stop by, you will not only get something refreshing to eat, you will also learn the name of that fruit in French, hear a little about how it is used in French cooking, and leave with a small taste of the culture and warmth that we carry from home. Get off your bike, sit down in the shade, enjoy a piece of fruit, and let us share a little bit of France with you. Everyone is welcome, always.

## Freqz of Love

**Where:** 8:00 & E · **From:** San Diego · **Landmark:** Lighted heart flag over triangle shade lounge · **Year:** 2026

Our camp is a cozy, heart-centered lounge where burners can relax, reset, and connect. We host interactive experiences like breathwork, oracle pulls, numerology, movement sessions, and playful recovery activities for dusty travelers. Stop by to add a message to our wedding and affirmation backdrops, grab some shade, and join whatever is happening in the moment. With ambient music, comfy seating, and a welcoming crew, our space is made for slowing down and meeting new friends. Come recharge and share the love frequency.

## Friendlandia

**Where:** A & 8:45 · **From:** Fremont · **Landmark:** Colorful neon flags across a shaded portico. · **Year:** 2026

We have many customs and traditions for celebrating and recognizing romantic relationships. However, friendships are often longer lasting and as strong as many marriages, and yet we often don't spend the time to celebrate and honor those relationships. Friendlandia is a place to celebrate new and long-time Friendships in ceremony by sharing vows, exchanging Friendship Bracelets, and expressing dedication and love for the friends in your life. Come have a ceremony at our Temple of Friendgagement, exchange vows and Friendship Bracelets, and become BFFs--Burner Friends Forever.

*More: https://www.facebook.com/friendlandia*

## Fucking Joe Camp

**Where:** 8:00 & B · **From:** San Jose · **Landmark:** Pole dancing platform / lit orange rotating beacon · **Year:** 2026

Welcome to Fucking Joe Camp! Where everybody knows your name, and we're always glad you came!

## GDI's - Gawd Damn Independents

**Where:** G & 8:15 · **From:** Reno, San Diego, Calgary · **Landmark:** Mailbox with GDI's and 8:14+G on it · **Year:** 2026

We're the GDI's (Gawd Damn Independents) and we're all working for the Man. We're Nevada Burners, plus one gawd damn Canuck - all with "Playa MacGyver" skills. So; drop in - late afternoon or late night as you might catch us enjoying a hot coffee or cold one...after work. Walk up; dust off a chair and share your best "There was this one time at Burning Man" story around our fire-pit. We might trade a trinket, a laugh, or one of our stories for your damn effort. We have Burned forever, and we long the days of Cacophonic playa snark; however - if speed past our camp on a 'lectric bike - we'll yelling at you "SLOW the F*** down...". Dusty hugs and squinty eyed smiles back at yah; "In Dust - We can Trust". Peace, Love & Hugs - the GDI's. (insert tools, smiley, dust and campfire "emojis")

*More: https://gallery.burningman.org/search/?q=mark+mennie*

## Giants Workshop Saloon

**Where:** 8:30 & E · **From:** Hudson Valley · **Landmark:** Scaffolding with Giant's Workshop banners (lit) · **Year:** 2026

We could be anything—including a dusty saloon run by Giants, come by for our nightly Sunset Socials for a variety of offerings of music, food, and drinks! Our saloon doors are open 24 hours, stop by anytime to see if the bar is open or just to rest your weary boots. A variety of workshops will be happening throughout the week, roll on through and see what we're up to!

## Groove Oasis

**Where:** C & 8:15 · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** "Neon" Lotus Heart Logo Sign · **Year:** 2026

Groove Oasis is your refuge in the dusty desert to rest or move your body. We are hosting dance workshops and parties throughout the week so check the playa schedule and come get your groove on!

*More: http://www.grooveoasis.com/*

## HeeBeeGeeBee Healers

**Where:** F & 8:15 · **From:** Boulder · **Landmark:** green parachute tents with "HBGB" flags · **Year:** 2026

We are BRC's long-standing oasis for nurturing, grounding and healing. Stop by to hang out and chill, take a class, or to receive a healing session for the mind, body and spirit.

*More: http://www.heebeegeebeehealers.org*

## Hiburnia

**Where:** 8:45 & J · **From:** Lafayette, CA · **Landmark:** hiburnia bar · **Year:** 2026

Serving delicious honey, Agave & Clove, infused hot Teas at sunrise and sunset every day. Temple Builders Drink for Free

## Hodge Podge

**Where:** C & 8:45 · **From:** Portland · **Landmark:** Wooden Deck with sleepy eyes on the leftside · **Year:** 2026

Hodge Podge - Come chill in our cafe. Come sip on espresso drink! Bring your own milk and we will make you a latte. Sporadic horse racing, doodling, and poetry fights.

## Honkers Harbor

**Where:** D & 8:15 · **From:** Portland, OR · **Landmark:** Neon Pink LED Sign - Honkers Harbor on it · **Year:** 2026

Calling all curious birds, early risers, and soulful squawkers. If you've been flying solo or searching for your flock, Honkers Harbor might be your next cozy nest. We're a neighborhood sanctuary for honkers, wanderers, and high-flyers - rooted in connection, ease, and a little morning magic. Perch beneath fluttering fabrics. Start your day with a warm breakfast or a hydrating refreshment. Settle into a soundscape that drifts between mellow, mindful, and playful. Come as you are - sleepy, sparkly, or somewhere in between. Stay for connection, conversation, and a place to land before the day takes flight. We invite you to gather, nourish, and share a little magic - one honk at a time.

## HORIZON

**Where:** Esplanade & 8:45 · **From:** Fort Lauderdale · **Landmark:** The Tall aerial Truss Rig and The Horizon Sign · **Year:** 2026

Horizon was originally Inspired by the unobstructed view of the open playa - a space beyond the city's limits, where the sun meets the mountains over the vast and empty desert - we gather to create a community built around ideals of curiosity, art, and celebration. Over the years Horizon has moved from the outer rim to plazas and to front lines of Esplanade. No matter where we are on playa we are always thrilled to call it our home.
